notes.title: Day One: Сharacters
notes.content:
We tell you more about the characters you're about to meet in the supremacist world of Hannah Day:

[h3]Hannah herself![/h3]
Dreamy and optimistic personality. Great at singing!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898808/51d64dacc23331a871ae9328002715c98d4b9a74.jpg[/img]

[h3]Hannah's parents[/h3]
Very fond of Hannah, but don't always fully understand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898808/d15b09043513bcf3899fe67a0ca94f0b76332d33.jpg[/img]

[h3]Stella[/h3]
Hannah's best friend. An empowered and confident pianist, but going through a difficult time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898808/5503ac069ab4c729fa5577c67929a1c4e19d7752.jpg[/img]

[h3]Nick[/h3]
Who do you picture when you hear the expression "a real drummer"? Yep, that's Nick! In love with Hannah (and it's no secret).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898808/b33d4a4bad47329e635a591cf4bf9fece437a586.jpg[/img]

[h3]Mike[/h3]
A hesitant and shy but very gifted violinist. In love with Stella (but that's a secret...).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44898808/df4c254cb3b8d09a3482f86d155085a73652bdf3.jpg[/img]

Grab your skateboard and head out to find your friends. After all, tonight's performance will determine whether parents will realize: for Hannah, music is life itself!
